title: paperpush venue database
description: Schema for venues.json. The top-level object maps a venue slug to a venue definition. Generated from the Field/Venue dataclasses in paperpush/database.py; run scripts/gen_venues_schema.py to regenerate.

propertyNames.description: Venue slug. The canonical identifier is the lowercase slug; case variants collapse to one venue at load time.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the venue; the key used in the .sub file and for inheritance merges.

label.description: Human-readable prompt shown for the field.

options_file.description: Name of a newline-separated keyword file under `venues/_assets/` whose lines become this field's `options`. Lets a long controlled vocabulary live in one shared text file instead of being inlined (and duplicated) in the database. When set, it supersedes any inline `options`.

options_recommended.description: For a `choice`/`multichoice` field, whether `options` is advisory (a value outside the list is a WARNING, not an ERROR) rather than a closed set.

accept.description: Permitted file extensions for `file`/`filelist`, e.g. [".pdf", ".docx"]. Omit (not []) when the upload imposes no extension restriction.

fields.description: Sub-field (column) names for a structured multi-item field such as an `authorlist` or a pipe-delimited `textarea` (funding, suggested reviewers). Each item line is `|`-delimited in this order. A trailing `?` marks an optional column (e.g. `department?`); every other column is required -- validation flags an item whose required column is blank. Author name and the `corresponding` flag have their own checks and are always effectively required regardless of marker.

type_options.description: Per-file 'file type' dropdown choices applied to this field's uploads.

min_count.description: Inclusive lower bound on item count for a multi-item field (multichoice selections, filelist/authorlist/list-textarea lines).

max_count.description: Inclusive upper bound on item count for a multi-item field.

word_count.description: Maximum length in words for a `text`/`textarea` value.

character_count.description: Maximum length in characters for a `text`/`textarea` value.

require_url.description: For a `text`/`textarea`, require each non-blank line of the value to be a valid http/https URL.

max_words_before_refs.description: For a manuscript `file`, the maximum word count of the main text before the reference list.

max_pages_before_refs.description: For a manuscript `file` (PDF), the maximum page count before the reference list.

max_words.description: For a manuscript `file`, the maximum word count of the whole document (references included).

max_pages.description: For a manuscript `file`, the maximum page count of the whole document. Verified for PDF; for .docx a best-effort cached count.

max_words_before_refs_by.description: `max_words_before_refs` selected by a sibling field's value (e.g. by article type).

max_pages_before_refs_by.description: `max_pages_before_refs` selected by a sibling field's value.

max_words_by.description: `max_words` selected by a sibling field's value.

max_pages_by.description: `max_pages` selected by a sibling field's value (e.g. Bioinformatics' page cap by article type).

min_value.description: Inclusive lower bound on the numeric value of an `int` field.

max_value.description: Inclusive upper bound on the numeric value of an `int` field.

max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size, in megabytes, of each individual file uploaded for a `file`/`filelist` field. Distinct from the venue-level max_upload_mb.

autofill.description: How an autofill engine may populate the field: extract | classify | filemap | never. Empty string means infer from `type`.

confirm.description: For a required `boolean`, whether it is a consent checkbox that must be affirmative (vs. an informational yes/no question).

required_if.description: Id of another field in the same venue; when that field has a non-empty value, this field becomes required. Combined with `required` (unconditional).

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the slug when omitted.

venue_type.description: Kind of venue: a preprint server, a journal, or a conference.

file_type_options.description: Labels offered by the portal's per-file 'file type' dropdown (venue-level because the same dropdown applies to every upload).

max_upload_mb.description: Maximum combined size, in megabytes, of all files in one submission.

deprecated.description: Hidden from listings but still reachable by get_venue.

inherits.description: Slug this venue inherits its field schema from. Empty/absent for a standalone venue. Distinct from submission sharing (which portal/runner/login a venue submits through), which is defined in code, not here.

removed_fields.description: Inherited field ids to drop. Only meaningful on an inheriting venue.

then.description: Inheriting venue: field entries are partial overrides; removed_fields is allowed.

else.description: Standalone venue: every field must be a full definition and removed_fields is not applicable.

field.description: Id of the sibling field whose value selects the limit.

values.description: Map from the selector field's value to the limit that applies.

default.description: Limit used when the selector's value is absent from `values`. None means no limit applies then.
